name: Hire Carousel
description: A 'set up once, runs itself' hero with an expanding, auto-cycling carousel of automation agents: four collapsed vertical cards (rotated name/role + a token-SVG character) and one open card showing a headline, a large character, and an FluentCRM-style app window with a typewriter tooltip.
interactions: one card is open at a time; opening animates flex-basis + width 96px->1000px over 700ms cubic-bezier(.65,.05,.2,1), the character grows 150px->300px and slides, and the content cross-fades in (400ms, 150ms delay)
auto-advance: setInterval steps to the next agent every 5000ms; any interaction resets the timer
clicking a card, pressing Enter/Space on a focused card, or clicking a mobile dot opens that agent
the open card's tooltip types its string char by char (32ms/char) with a blinking cursor (wpmn-hc-blink 1s steps(1))
under 760px the rail collapses to a single card plus a dot switcher; 1040-760px the whole rail scales to fit the viewport
prefers-reduced-motion: no auto-advance, no typewriter (full tooltip shown), transitions and cursor blink off
